Earlier this year, after allowing iPhone users to add a second account within the same app, WhatsApp is now exploring support for up to three accounts. Here are the details.

WhatsApp will support up to three accounts

Last June, WhatsApp officially launched multi-account support on iPhone, allowing users to add a second account within the same app.

After several months of beta testing, the feature was rolled out, eliminating the need for users to rely on WhatsApp Business as an alternative for managing a second account.

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp appears to be working on expanding this feature, allowing users to switch between up to three accounts without having to log out.

WABetaInfo reports:

The report adds that each account will retain its own chat history, notifications, privacy settings, backups, and media.

WABetaInfo notes that while two accounts are sufficient for many users, this feature will be very useful for those who need to handle different combinations of work and personal phone numbers.

That said, the feature is still in development and has not yet been made available to beta testers, meaning it may still be some time before a wider rollout.
